name: prompt-compiler-gpt
description: Agent Project Compiler (APC): compile ideas, interviews, files, references, and research into durable provider-neutral project authorities using a single always-active kernel and progressive JIT routing.

interface.longDescription: Compile product intent and evidence into durable, provider-neutral project authorities. Uses one canonical always-active compiler kernel, progressive JIT routing, context-freshness recovery, Fresh-Agent Reconstruction, and optional companion Core-First governance when installed.
defaultPrompt: Compile this project idea into a durable implementation-ready package.
Audit this project package for missing product, realization, or verification truth.
Continue this compiled project from its current authorities and evidence.
